answer: Each identity must finish a copper chain of five linked tasks per epoch: each input derives from the previous output, so work cannot be copied or split across fake accounts. An umber stain marks any identity missing its deadline or reusing output: its locked rewards burn, its slot revoked three epochs, its sponsor's slot lost too. Each chain costs 18,000 POA, so 1,000 fakes cost 18,000,000 POA per epoch while an honest agent pays 18,000 once. The walnut only opens for the agent that did the work. Limitation: honest agents on slow hardware can miss the deadline and be frozen unfairly.
